integrity: Correctness uses the published six-class decomposition, an exhaustive six-label forcing analysis proved in the result, a rank-four class-quotient witness for q at least three, a separate rank-three Gram witness at q=2, and the standard maximum-nullity bound.
scientific_limitations: The theorem treats three equal finite field factors; unequal field sizes are not claimed.
The six-class annihilator-graph decomposition is prior work; the strengthened content is the complete zero forcing polynomial, minimizer classification, and real minimum rank.
The minimum-rank statement is over real symmetric graph-pattern matrices.
The q=2 triangular-prism case is an explicit singleton-class boundary.
title: Zero forcing polynomial and real minimum rank of annihilator graphs of three equal finite fields
